author: Ruben Hassid
basis: Prescriptive rollout playbook demonstrated with a fictional law firm
reported_outcomes: Provides a fictional setup and suggested before/after exercise, not measured whole-team adoption or competence gains.
proposed_outcomes: Make a recurring workflow accessible and gather colleague feedback.
limits: A selected wow result encourages confirmation bias; tone and format do not establish legal or factual correctness.
Workspace-wide sharing may violate existing access boundaries.
Claims that a team plan makes every upload safe are not adopted.
review_note: Merge reusable examples and colleague feedback into Mollick’s loop. Flag impressive-demo-only evaluation as a failure case, not evidence of learning.
coverage: Close-read all 473 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
